name: Example Module
description: REFERENCE module template — the copyable shape of an IFA module manifest. Copy this file, rename the template_id (immutable slug), and point emits[] at your own event type(s). A manifest is DATA, not code: it declares what the module is and which event types it may emit; the typed payload schemas live in the event_types registry, referenced by (event_type, event_type_version) — never embedded here. Must validate against module_manifest@2.schema.json. See docs/AUTHORING_A_MODULE.md.

inputs.name: shift_log
inputs.description: Example data input: who is on shift, so events can name them.

config_schema.description: Per-instance config. Values live on the backend (module_instances.config) and are pulled by the edge producer via GET /v1/instance — tune them in the DB, not on the box.

min_confidence.description: Drop detections below this confidence before emitting.

emit_interval_seconds.description: How often the reference producer emits an event.
